label_policy: Grade2 direct supported answer/constraint; grade1 actionable partial without topic-only overlap. Labels frozen before scores.
limitations: Small synthetic coding-domain independent set; not production distribution or task-level utility. Author blind to threshold/dev scores/errors.

case_rationales.p02: m02 directly names the remapping flag and its diagnostic-message boundary.

case_rationales.p04: m04 directly states the stored axis order and CRS before exchange conversion.
case_rationales.p05: m05 directly gives script/language setup and required-versus-optional feature order.
case_rationales.p06: m06 directly supplies the drift cause and fixed opsz value; m19 names the resolved-axis diagnostic location but supplies no default policy or value, so grade 1.
case_rationales.p07: m07 directly specifies the header version, lowercase representation, and both ID lengths.
case_rationales.p08: m08 directly gives the baggage-key predicate and confirms trace IDs stay available.
case_rationales.p09: m09 directly establishes aggregation and final rounding, while m10 directly supplies the requested available storage precision; both requested subparts are grade 2.
case_rationales.p10: m21 directly requires decimal-string parsing and forbids binary-float construction; m22 gives the concrete diagnostic location to check the active parser but does not prescribe construction, so grade 1.
case_rationales.p11: m11 directly requires explicit fold selection or rejection for this manual Berlin input.
case_rationales.p12: m12 directly selects the later repeated New York occurrence and records its assumption.
case_rationales.p13: m13 directly requires NFC and gives the concrete reason NFKC is forbidden.
case_rationales.p14: m14 directly separates preserved display code points from NFC duplicate comparison.
case_rationales.p15: m15 and m31 are independently applicable grade-2 answers to the same TLV-extension need: each requires unknown optional extensions to survive relay forwarding unchanged.
case_rationales.p16: m16 directly gives unsigned-varint encoding and the 16 MiB pre-allocation limit.
case_rationales.n01: Compiler memories discuss archive determinism, path remapping, symbols, diagnostics, and source maps; none supplies a cache-eviction policy or actionable eviction parameter.
case_rationales.n02: Geospatial memories define axes, CRS, tiles, and boundary classification; none explains antimeridian cutting or self-intersection repair.
case_rationales.n03: Font memories cover shaping, optical size, fallback, and line breaking; none selects color-glyph palettes or dark-background treatment.
case_rationales.n04: Tracing memories cover headers, baggage filtering, sampling, and clocks; none contains a graph algorithm for critical-path computation.
case_rationales.n05: The corpus mandates HALF_EVEN for a different summary task and contains no stochastic-rounding simulation method; the contradictory existing rule is grade 0.
case_rationales.n06: Time memories define ambiguity and gap handling for named workflows; none provides future timezone-rule acquisition for arbitrary regions.
case_rationales.n07: Unicode memories cover NFC, filename comparison, and grapheme-safe truncation; none gives bidi-control detection or safe source rendering.
case_rationales.n08: Binary memories specify framing, TLV evolution, enum preservation, and length bounds; none compares compression algorithms or CPU tradeoffs.
case_rationales.n09: Compiler memories contain no third-party-runtime licensing requirement or generated-code notice.
case_rationales.n10: Geospatial memories contain no label-layout or collision-resolution method across zoom levels.
case_rationales.n11: Font memories contain no Icelandic hyphenation dictionary or language-specific fallback selection rule.
case_rationales.n12: Tracing memories describe wire and collector behavior only; none identifies a mobile gesture-instrumentation SDK.
case_rationales.o01: No corpus row concerns thermal control loops, thermistors, or PID tuning.
case_rationales.o02: No corpus row concerns duct acoustics, vibration measurement, or resonance diagnosis.
